name: Interstellar
blurb: Nolan's space epic about a father who leaves his dying Earth to find humanity a new home
title: Interstellar Explained: Plot Summary and Ending
description: Interstellar explained: the characters, the full plot from the dust storms to the black hole Gargantua, and the ending explained.
h1: Interstellar Explained: Plot, Characters and Ending
answer: Interstellar is a 2014 science-fiction film directed by Christopher Nolan, written with his brother Jonathan Nolan, starring Matthew McConaughey, Anne Hathaway and Jessica Chastain. In the near future, dust storms and crop blight are killing Earth's farms, and humanity is running out of food. Joseph Cooper, a former NASA pilot turned farmer, is recruited by a secret NASA programme to fly through a wormhole near Saturn in search of a planet people could live on, leaving behind his young daughter Murph. Physicist Kip Thorne, later a Nobel laureate, worked on the film as executive producer and scientific consultant, and its black hole and time-dilation effects are built on real physics.

body: Beginning. Cooper farms with his children, Murph and Tom, and his father-in-law Donald. Murph believes a ghost is pushing books off her bedroom shelves. After a dust storm, sand settles on her floor in lines that Cooper recognises as binary code giving coordinates. Following them, he and Murph find a hidden NASA base run by Professor Brand. Brand explains that a wormhole appeared near Saturn 48 years earlier, apparently placed there by some unknown intelligence, leading to a distant galaxy. Twelve volunteers of the Lazarus missions went through to scout planets; three, Miller, Edmunds and Mann, sent back promising signals. NASA has two plans: Plan A, in which Brand solves a gravity equation that would let huge stations lift Earth's population into space, and Plan B, in which the Endurance carries 5,000 frozen embryos to found a colony. Cooper agrees to pilot the ship. Murph, furious, refuses to say goodbye; he leaves her a matching wristwatch and promises to come back.

Middle. After two years' travel, the Endurance passes through the wormhole. The planets orbit a giant black hole, Gargantua, whose gravity slows time. Miller's planet is so close that every hour there equals seven years outside. Cooper, Brand and Doyle land and find only wreckage, the planet's ocean rises in a mountain-sized wave, and Doyle is killed. By the time they return to the ship, 23 years have passed; Romilly has aged waiting, and Cooper watches decades of video messages from his children. Murph, now a NASA scientist working with Professor Brand, hears his deathbed confession: the equation cannot be finished without data from inside a black hole, so Plan A was never going to work as promised, and he never expected the crew to return.

Short on fuel, the crew picks Mann's frozen planet over Edmunds', against Amelia Brand's wish; she loves Edmunds and argues for his world. Mann, woken from cryosleep, reports that his planet can support life. In fact he faked his data so someone would come and rescue him. He cracks Cooper's helmet and leaves him to die, Romilly is killed by a booby trap at Mann's base, and Mann flees to the Endurance. Amelia rescues Cooper. Mann's reckless attempt to dock kills him and wrecks part of the ship; Cooper saves it with a spinning docking manoeuvre.

End. With too little fuel to reach Edmunds' planet, Cooper uses a slingshot past Gargantua that costs 51 years of Earth time. To lighten the ship he and TARS detach and fall into the black hole, letting Amelia and CASE go on. Cooper finds himself in a tesseract, a space made of Murph's bedroom at every moment in time. He realises he was her ghost: he pushes books to spell out STAY to his past self and sends the coordinates. Then TARS gives him the quantum data recorded inside the black hole, and Cooper encodes it in Morse code in the ticking second hand of the watch he gave Murph. On Earth, the adult Murph returns to the farmhouse, understands the message, and solves the equation.

What happens: the tesseract closes and Cooper drifts out near Saturn, where he is rescued and wakes on Cooper Station, a huge orbiting habitat. Murph's equation worked, Plan A happened, and humanity has left Earth; the station is named after her. Because of time dilation Cooper has barely aged, while Murph is very old and dying, surrounded by her family. She tells him not to stay to watch her die but to go to Amelia Brand. Meanwhile Amelia has reached Edmunds' planet, found that he died there, and is setting up a camp with CASE. Cooper takes a ship and sets off with TARS to find her.

ul: Who are 'they'? Cooper concludes in the tesseract that the beings who placed the wormhole and built the tesseract are not aliens but humans from the far future, who have learned to live in more dimensions than our three plus time.

Is it a paradox? Yes, in the sense that future humans only survive because Cooper sent the data, and he could only send it because they rescued him. Critics often call this a bootstrap or causal loop; the film presents a closed loop rather than a past that gets changed.

Is it science or love? Amelia argues earlier that love may be something that crosses dimensions, and Cooper realises his bond with Murph is what lets him find the right moment in time. The film treats this as emotional truth rather than physics, and viewers disagree about how literally to take it.

What about the science? Kip Thorne wrote a book, The Science of Interstellar, separating what in the film is established physics (time dilation near a black hole, wormhole visuals) from what is speculation (what happens inside a black hole).

body: The ending is open only in what Cooper will find on Edmunds' planet; whether he survived the black hole is not seriously in doubt in the film itself.

ul: Parents and children: the whole film turns on Cooper's promise to Murph and the cost of every hour he spends away from her.
Time as a resource: time dilation means every decision on Miller's planet or around Gargantua is paid for in years of the lives back home.
Survival of the species versus the individual: Plans A and B, and Mann's betrayal, ask whether people can sacrifice themselves for a future they will never see.
Exploration: Cooper's belief that humans are meant to look up and leave, not just to survive on the ground, drives his choice to go.
Runtime: 169 minutes. English-language; released in November 2014.
An original screenplay, not an adaptation; Kip Thorne's companion book The Science of Interstellar explains the physics.
Content: rated PG-13 in the US; there is little violence beyond one fight between astronauts, but some scenes of peril and grief are intense.
No knowledge of physics is needed: the film explains time dilation, wormholes and black holes as it goes.

check.q: Why do 23 years pass while Cooper is on Miller's planet?
options: The crew was frozen in cryosleep by mistake
The planet is so close to the black hole that time runs far slower there
The wormhole sends them into the future
check.why: Gargantua's gravity slows time so much that each hour on Miller's planet equals seven years outside.

He found the solution to the gravity equation
check.why: Mann's planet could not support life; he sent false reports so a crew would come for him.

check.q: How does Cooper get the black-hole data to Murph?
options: He radios it from the Endurance
TARS flies it back to Earth
He encodes it in Morse code in the second hand of her watch
check.why: From the tesseract he moves the watch's second hand, which Murph decodes to solve the equation.

faq.q: Who was the ghost in Interstellar?
faq.a: Cooper himself, reaching back from the tesseract into Murph's bedroom to push books, send coordinates in the dust and move her watch's second hand.

faq.q: What happens to Amelia Brand at the end of Interstellar?
faq.a: She reaches Edmunds' planet with CASE, finds that Edmunds has died but that the planet seems habitable, and begins setting up a colony; Cooper leaves Cooper Station to join her.

faq.q: How old is Cooper at the end of Interstellar?
faq.a: By Earth's calendar he is well over a hundred years old, but because of time dilation and the black hole his body has aged only a few years since he left.
